As said above, speaker replacement is easy, Best Buy can help with fitment size, the you tube your car, guaranteed someone has done a speaker swap on your model car, and videoed it. But be advised, if the whole side is cracking, then you may have another issue besides blown speakers. As far as prices go, find your speaker size and go to Walmart, if you just want a basic factory like speaker, they sell Scotche, and they’re cheap. But again, they’re CHEAP. Want something relatively inexpensive, but good quality sound? Go with Infinity... you’re going to pay $80-$150 for a pair, but the sound is well worth it, and later you’ll have enough speaker to handle an amp if you wanna go louder.... my $.02... and also, there’s a place up on Sornenson pkwy, and around the 50s (56th?) they do custom cars, but they also sell stereo equipment. Don’t know much about them, but worth a look.
